map.输入瞳高相关测量值（瞳孔中心到镜框下缘垂直距离），评估是否满足渐进多焦点镜片的光: Enter the pupil height measurements (vertical distance from the pupil center to the bottom edge of the frame) to assess whether the optical center meets the positioning requirements of progressive multifocal lenses, assisting fitting and fabrication. Used for precise progressive lens fitting.
map.瞳高占 B 值比例 = 瞳高(mm) / 镜框 B 值(mm) × 100%: Pupil height as a share of B value = pupil height (mm) / frame B value (mm) x 100%
map.比例 50%–70% 为光学中心位置正常；偏低光学中心偏上、偏高偏下，影响装配与: A ratio of 50%-70% is a normal optical center position; too low puts the optical center high, too low puts it low, which affects fitting and visual quality.
map.渐进/双光片需测单眼瞳孔高度。: Progressive and bifocal lenses require a monocular pupil height measurement.
map.定光学中心垂直位置。: Define the vertical position of the optical center.
map.：镜圈下缘到瞳孔中心 22mm、通道 17mm → 近用区中心 22−17=5m: The distance from the lower rim of the lens to the pupil center is 22mm and the corridor is 17mm, so the near zone center is 22 - 17 = 5mm; mark it and align the optical center during assembly.
map.：瞳孔高差 2mm 致渐进通道偏，阅读区上移/下移造成「看不清近」或头晕，须重测: A 2mm pupil height difference shifts the progressive channel, and moving the near zone up or down causes "can't see near clearly" or dizziness, so re-measure.
map.要。脸不对称使左右瞳孔高不同，尤其渐进片，均分会导致一侧不适。: Yes. A facial asymmetry makes the left and right pupil heights differ, especially with progressive lenses, and averaging them leaves one side uncomfortable.
map.是。水平（单眼 PD）+ 垂直（瞳孔高）共同定位光学中心，缺一不可。: Yes. Horizontal (monocular PD) plus vertical (pupil height) together locate the optical center; neither is optional.
